LESSON: READING COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: READING Theme 2. Family Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested L
Topic 2.3: Reading Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Comprehension, part of READING Theme 2. Family Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested L in Grade 5 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: Why is reading important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read texts on the classroom and answer questions,

2. read texts on items found in the classroom and match to pictures,

3. read texts on the classroom and write descriptions of items found in their classroom,

4. research from online/ offline sources texts on classroom items and present in plenary for feedback.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read texts on the classroom and answer questions,
2. read texts on items found in the classroom and match to pictures,
3. read texts on the classroom and write descriptions of items found in their classroom,
4. research from online/ offline sources texts on classroom items and present in plenary for feedback.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: The learner develops researching skills as they research from online/ offline sources texts on classroom

items and present in plenary.

Values:
Respect: The learner observes rules of engagement as they research from online/ offline sources texts on classroom items and

present in plenary for feedback.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Education for Sustainable Development: The learner develops an awareness of sustainability as they read texts on the

classroom and write descriptions of items found in their classroom.

Link to other Learning Areas

The learner links the concept of writing descriptions of items found in their classroom to the concept of adjectives in English

and Kiswahili.
